exposure: Gestational age at delivery (moderate vs mild preterm)
cohort: 521 singleton pregnancies with moderate and mild preterm birth
finding: While delivery mode did not impact 5-minute Apgar scores overall, there was a higher incidence of SGA and cesarean delivery in the moderate preterm group, and delivery mode did affect Apgar scores in the SGA subgroup.
birth_weight: Varied, study focused on small for gestational age
